accepted_invariants: telemetry binds one exact concrete F2-WP-602 ChildReconcileEvidence identity and digest
finished monotonic time cannot precede started monotonic time
resource/token/tool/work counters are explicit non-negative canonical-JSON integers rather than inferred measurements
quality evidence remains opaque referenced evidence and is not converted into semantic quality, success or completion by WP605
provenance is mandatory and reference collections are canonical duplicate-free tuples
telemetry identity is content-bound and consumer verification rechecks telemetry and reconcile identities/digests
unknown fields such as a caller-injected success flag fail closed
evidence_note: Repository-hosted component CI proves only this exact deterministic telemetry/evidence contract at the bound source identities. It does not prove a child actually executed on target runtime, that quality evidence is favorable, or that any result is successful/completed/causally credited.
